summary: Iteration 4 (admin-only delete, host:port uniqueness, CSV dedup, Terraform host-grouping, Inventory Export JSON) fully verified. Backend: 41/41 pytest tests pass (12 new tests added for iter 4). Frontend: verified role-gated UI on /inventory for admin vs member, main.tf.json download from Inventory Export JSON, and Generator flow still generates 68 resources.
backend_tests_added: TestIter4AdminDelete: member DELETE /api/instances/{id} -> 403; member DELETE /api/instances?confirm=DELETE_ALL -> 403; admin single delete 200; admin delete-all 200
TestIter4HostPortUnique: duplicate host:port on POST -> 409; same host different port -> 200; PUT to another instance's host:port -> 409; PUT self with same host:port -> 200
TestIter4CsvDedup: re-importing /tmp/datatest.csv yields imported=0, skipped=5; within-file duplicate rows yield imported=2, skipped=1

TestIter4TerraformGrouping: two instances on host 10.0.0.5 (ports 3306 & 6379) produce exactly 1 aws_instance, 1 aws_security_group with ingress for BOTH ports, 2 A records referencing the SAME aws_instance, 2 SRV records each keyed to its own port (3306, 6379); ami sourced from inventory ami_id
frontend_verified: Admin on /inventory: export-csv-button, export-json-button, delete-all-button and per-row delete-{id} buttons all visible (5 rows -> 6 delete testids incl. delete-all).
export-json-button triggers browser download named 'main.tf.json' (verified via page.expect_download for both admin and member).
Member on /inventory (token swap via localStorage.if_token): delete-all-button count=0, per-row delete-* count=0, edit-* count=5, export-csv-button=1, export-json-button=1 (as required).
/generator: generate-tf-button renders HCL containing aws_instance; export-all-json-button and 'Generated 68 resources' toast confirmed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _assert_unique_hostport: correctly excludes self by id on update; only enforces uniqueness when host is non-empty (blank hosts allowed multiple times, which is reasonable for placeholder rows).
server.py import_csv: dedups against both DB and within-file via a seen-set keyed by (host, port). Response shape {imported, skipped} is stable and consumed by CsvUpload.jsx.

terraform_generator._build_resources: groups by host so ONE aws_instance per host with SG ingress rules aggregated per distinct port; DNS A records all reference the single grouped instance; SRV records still carry the specific member's port. Behavior matches spec.

Inventory.jsx: isAdmin gating on delete-{id} and delete-all-button is correct; export buttons remain visible to members. exportJson() calls generateTerraform({resources:'all', output_format:'json'}) and downloads main.tf.json.
Carry-over (unchanged, non-blocking): brute-force lockout keyed on (ip,email) still; terraform _hcl_val doesn't escape embedded quotes/backslashes; server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event.
Minor pytest deprecation warning: class-scoped fixtures defined as instance methods (PytestRemovedIn10Warning). Could be moved to @classmethod or module-level fixtures.
